<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>In the context of boundary conformal field theory, we derive a sum rule that relates two and three point functions of the displacement operator. For four dimensional conformal field theory with a three dimensional boundary, this sum rule in turn relates the two boundary contributions to the anomaly in the trace of the stress tensor. We check our sum rule for a variety of free theories and also for a weakly interacting theory, where a free scalar in the bulk couples marginally to a generalized free field on the boundary.</jats:p>
title: A sum rule for boundary contributions to the trace anomaly
